author: JingJang
body:
It's neat as a collectable but gold is rarely something you lack. 

I've seen some new and unusual weapons lately so it's cool to see another.

I have a handful of items like this that I keep around for fun.  My favorite is my Ornate Rusty Sword.  It's the most beautiful crappy weapon I have!

author: 27Xenon27
body: It's nice to have. Once you're T10 and powerful enough to not need a "real" offhand to farm world and (horde) dungeons, it's a good passive to have. I'd suggest you try to farm the offhands that give you arrowstorm and the aoe spell (can't remember the exact name, Lacuna or Lacunus or whatever). They're great for horde mode once you're strong enough

author: Looksees69
body: The gold bonus is nice but.. not that necessary, maybe you'll use it if you get a little gold broke from re-adorning but that's it. Don't know if it works in arena

author: infam0usx
body: IMO the only useful ones are Amadans Staff and Bricurus Bow. Especially the Staff as it allows to codex for stasis without having to switch to chrono.
